Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Mid-Century 2-Toned Stoneware Planter, 4.13"H, Gray and White
Materials: Stoneware
Add elegance to your room with this attractive 2-toned stoneware planter. With its simple gray-and-white design, this planter is an ideal accent for mid-century or modern-minimalist home decor, and it’s charming whether holding a plant or displayed empty. 5.12" diameter x 4.13"H 100% stoneware Bring this durable stoneware planter to life with colorful flowers, or use it as a simple home-decor piece. Wipe clean with a soft, dry cloth.
